subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the coordinated action-pin update be approved after an exact-head rebase and successful required checks, including the credential-bearing token, Codex, Docker publishing, and CodeQL actions?
rationale: These actions execute inside trusted workflows with secrets or security responsibilities, so repository intent and upstream trust acceptance cannot be delegated to automated patch review alone.

options.title: Approve after exact-head verification
options.body: Rebase, require the relevant checks to complete on that head, review upstream release changes for sensitive actions, and merge the coordinated update if no regression appears.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker publishing, and CodeQL revisions into smaller PRs if maintainers want independent rollout and rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head verification
recommendation.body: Rebase, require the relevant checks to complete on that head, review upstream release changes for sensitive actions, and merge the coordinated update if no regression appears.
